product_name: HMD Touch 4G, World's First Hybrid Phone | Enjoy Chatting & Video Calls via Express Chat (Works with Android & iOS), Cloud Phone Apps, Wi-Fi & Hotspot, 1 Year Replacement Guarantee | Cyan
description: Supports Video Calling & Chatting via Express Chat App, which works with HMD Touch 4G devices, Android & iOS. The HMD Touch 4G comes with WiFi & Hotspot capabilities, to ensure you can always stay connected. Enjoy social media apps, video streaming, games, news and much more via the built-in Cloud Phone Apps. Other features like Auto Call Recording, long-lasting battery life, selfie camera, and Type-C charging truly makes this the Hybrid Phone.
